part_number.product: SEL-551C Overcurrent and Reclosing Relay (Conventional Terminal Blocks)

prefix.description: SEL-551C Overcurrent and Reclosing Relay, conventional terminal blocks (0551 model designator + fixed 'C0')

part_number.note: 12-digit MOT string of the form 0551C0 P C S K M X, where positions 1-6 are the fixed prefix 0551C0 (0551 model designator, then a fixed 'C 0'). The configurable digits are Power Supply; Control Input Voltage (7), Conformal Coat (8), Secondary Input Current (9), Packaging (10), and Communications Port (11); position 12 is a fixed trailing 'X'. Unlike the plain SEL-551, the SEL-551C combines power supply and control input voltage into a single digit (7). This device has no drawing layers, so positions are calibrated against the real part number 0551C0BX5X1X (from the SEL-551C instruction manual, Figure 8.2) plus the WI-4991 Model Option Table; every option code and column was confirmed by both.
references: SEL-551C Instruction Manual (551C_IM_20250131; real part number 0551C0BX5X1X)

example_part_numbers.note: Example from the SEL-551C instruction manual (Relay Part Number sticker, Figure 8.2): 48/125 Vdc or 125 Vac supply with 125 Vdc level-sensitive inputs, no conformal coat, 5 A phase / 5 A neutral, horizontal rack mount, EIA-232 rear port.

positions.label: Power Supply; Control Input Voltage
positions.note: A single digit jointly selects the power supply range and the control (optoisolated) input voltage.

options.1: 24 Vdc power supply; 24 Vdc control inputs
options.A: 48/125 Vdc or 125 Vac power supply; 48 Vdc control inputs (level sensitive)
options.B: 48/125 Vdc or 125 Vac power supply; 125 Vdc control inputs (level sensitive)
options.E: 48/125 Vdc or 125 Vac power supply; 110 Vdc control inputs (level sensitive)
options.C: 125/250 Vdc or Vac power supply; 220 Vdc control inputs (level sensitive)
options.D: 125/250 Vdc or Vac power supply; 250 Vdc control inputs (level sensitive)

options.P: Part of two-relay rack mount package
options.B: Single relay assembled with rack mount bracket 9100 (bracket on right side in front view)
options.C: Single relay with rack mount bracket 9102 with cutout for test switch (bracket on right side in front view)

positions.label: Communications Port
positions.note: EIA-485 is for special applications only; SEL recommends EIA-232.

options.4: EIA-232 front port and EIA-485 rear port

positions.label: Trailing Digit
positions.note: Fixed trailing digit 'X' shown constant in the WI-4991 part-number template and the real part number 0551C0BX5X1X.
